I'll coordinate the package build with Rishi (for export tooling) and Marissa (for evidence delivery). If the pre-signed S3 option works, please share the destination S3 bucket role or an SFTP endpoint and preferred KMS.

Thanks — sending draft artifacts Weds.

Attachments: finco_access_export_sample.csv (stub), export_schema_v2.json (stub), redwood_evidence_readme.pdf (stub)

Summary of key controls:  
- Timestamps: RFC3339 with milliseconds (UTC).
- PII handling: we populate pii_hash with SHA256(email_lowercase + global_salt_v1) and include a redaction_flag when full redaction applied. The sample uses synthetic emails hashed for demonstration.
- Retention: Logs retained by default for 365 days in hosted mode; Dedicated/Private deployments support configurable retention from 30 days to 7 years depending on legal requirements. Per-account retention is supported via config; for region-specific residency we export from the customer's region boundary and can provide region-scoped snapshots.
- Delivery: We recommend pre-signed S3 or SFTP for audit handoffs. Drive is available for small samples and will be time-limited; all delivery is encrypted in transit and at rest.

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm delivery mechanism (S3 role / SFTP endpoint / Drive preference).
- Marissa: I can produce final packaged ZIP and upload to pre-signed S3 once destination info received.
